newsitem.title: USA: LPC - American Radio eyes bank financing for merger.
newsitem.headline: LPC - American Radio eyes bank financing for merger.

text.p: NEW YORK, Nov 4 (LPC) - American Radio Systems Corp is lining up bank financing of $800 million to $1.0 billion for its merger with EZ Communications Inc, banking sources said.
BNY Capital Markets and Chase Manhattan Corp are among the banks bidding to lead the financing, a banker said.
The credit, which will refinance existing loans totaling $475 million, also will be used for future acquisitions, sources said.
A mandate will be awarded next week.

Pricing and structure of the deal were not available, though sources said the new facility likely would have tighter pricing than the 250 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR) that American Radio is paying on its existing 7.75-year revolver put in place by BNY in December 1995, a banker said.
